title: A term-by-term variational multiscale method with dynamic subscales for incompressible turbulent aerodynamics
summary: Variational multiscale (VMS) methods offer a robust framework for handling under-resolved flow scales without resorting to problem-specific turbulence models. Here, we propose and assess a dynamic, term-by-term VMS stabilized formulation for simulating incompressible flows from laminar to turbulent regimes.
